title: Compressing Streaming Neural Audio Encoders via Latent-Space Distillation
excerpt: System-wide Dictation on Apple devices runs entirely on-device, and the speech it transcribes reaches the foundation model through a tokenizer: an encoder that maps short windows of waveform onto the representation the language model reads. Because that model is sparsely activated under Instruction-Following Pruning, only a small subset of its experts occupies DRAM at any time, so the always-on tokenizer competes for the same memory, and its parameter count bears directly on power and latency. title: A Practical Recipe for Semi-Supervised Federated ASR: Online Pseudo-Labels with Server Update Stabilization
